steps.title: Hire a social media specialist to rework the online channel
steps.why: When sales dip, the channel that brings in new customers is the first place worth professional attention. A specialist can restructure the Facebook / Instagram content plan systematically.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for a fresh product photo batch
steps.why: Old photos stop feeling new to your audience. A fresh batch lifts every piece of marketing that uses them.

steps.title: Hire a copywriter to rewrite ads and promotions
steps.why: Ad and promotion copy carries a lot of the selling. A copywriter can produce text that speaks to the customer rather than just announcing the product.

steps.title: Trial TikTok / Reels video content
steps.why: Short-form video is an effective way to reach new audiences. A small starter batch lets you test without a big commitment.
